greeting: You're mid-charter off the Croatian coast with the whole day open on the water. The one thing worth catching before signal drops is Saturday's handoff back to dry land.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat shore transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: Three arrangements need doing from land before the charter ends Saturday noon: the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, a bag hold at the Remisens, and a pre-dawn checkout for the 7:30 AM flight. Signal is poor once underway, so lock them today.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap, Sept 20-22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday at 3:55 PM but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday. The nights of the 20th and 21st in St Pete still have nowhere booked.

needsAttention.title: Sept 20-Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: You land Sunday with no car reserved. A full-size SUV out of TPA needs booking before you arrive, jet-lagged, to Sunday walk-up rates.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Claudia Kruse
flagged.detail: A message from three days ago you haven't opened - worth a look given the governance network.

flagged.title: Revolut account now active
flagged.detail: Card ordered and verified, and a $366.63 payment to Mladen Franic went through - likely the Croatia transfer.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto autumn conference
flagged.detail: Registration invite for the governance conference - a networking fit worth a decision before it fills.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promotions - Bloomberg, NYT Cooking, Apple, GHA, a few retailers.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply from you.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: Autumn's winter squash is at its sweetest now, perfect for a from-scratch pie.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas SUV out of Portland (refundable)
Check for a better St Pete Airbnb before the charge hits

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar - the last full morning of the charter is yours on the water.
The practical window: sort Saturday's Cavtat transfers and the St Pete gap while you still have a signal.
Last night aboard before Saturday's noon disembark at Komolac.
